Kill the [[Charr Fire Caller]]s in [[The Breach]] for the bottle of [[Fiery Unguent]] for [[Shalev the Hermit]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = elementalist
}}

===Objectives===
*Go to the Breach and kill Charr Fire Callers to obtain a bottle of fiery unguent.
*Return to Shalev the Hermit for your reward.

===Reward===
*300 [[Experience]]
* 75 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Eruption}} 
*{{skill icon|Shard Storm}}

==Walkthrough==
Find Shalev in a cave on the western border of Old Ascalon, west-northwest of [[Sardelac Sanitarium]]. Map travel or navigate to [[Piken Square]]. Cross the small valley to the west and climb the path to the right (watching for Charr patrols) to find up to three Charr Fire Callers. When defeated, one will drop a bottle of fiery unguent. Bring it back to Shalev for the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Shalev the Hermit
:''"Shalev is isolated as he wishes to be, but unfortunately, the gargoyles don't always respect Shalev's desire for privacy. To keep unwanted guests at bay, Shalev has devised a powerful spell. He requires one last ingredient to make the spell complete and keep the gargoyles at bay. In the Breach, there are Charr known as '''Fire Callers'''. These Fire Callers often carry with them a certain '''fiery unguent''' that Shalev must have. What say you to an exchange of knowledge for a bottle of this fiery unguent?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'll retrieve the fiery unguent.
| decline = You'll have to find someone else.
| ask = To the Breach with you! Find the '''Fire Callers''' and bring Shalev a bottle of '''fiery unguent'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Shalev the Hermit
:''"Shalev thanks you for the fiery unguent. Now then, take what was promised and leave Shalev to his solitude."''
